name: yiibu
title_zh: 手机素材丢进文件夹，出来就是能发的 9:16 成片
tagline_zh: 剪映里耗两小时的活——静音切除、双语逐词字幕、B-roll、背景乐闪避——它一次跑完，每道关卡卡住不过就不出片。
tagline_en: Hours in CapCut become one pass: silence cut, word-timed bilingual captions, B-roll, ducked music—blocking gates.
desc_en: 一步 — auto-edit a folder of phone clips into a publish-ready 9:16 short, quality enforced by blocking gates. Silence removal, two-layer captions (word-timed, bilingual), B-roll, music bed with ducking. Use when user says "剪影片", "後製", "yiibu", "一步", "video postprod", "edit video".
why_zh: 不是一键出片的花架子，是带质检闸门的流水线：每步不过就停，宁可卡住也不放废片出门。
why_en: Not a one-click toy—a gated pipeline. Each stage must pass quality checks or it halts, refusing to ship garbage.
limit_zh: 只认手机竖拍素材，横屏或专业摄影机素材不处理；字幕只做中英双语，其他语种需自备词典；B-roll 从本地素材库抽。
limit_en: Phone vertical footage only; no landscape or cinema cam. Captions are zh/en only. B-roll from local library, no web search. Outputs 9:16 MP4 only.
title_en: Drop phone clips in a folder, get a publish-ready 9:16 short
